technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with bullish short-term MA cross and positive volume signals offset by price below key EMAs, weak trend strength (ADX 23.89), and bearish stochastic cross—moderate confluence but elevated execution risk.

fundamental.summary: AAL shows no insider buying conviction, zero institutional accumulation signals, no government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 10 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (280+ days old) with only junior-level small sales; no recent conviction signals.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (355.36), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, high-impact CPI event in 2 days, and earnings binary in 10 days create compounded risk environment unsuitable for directional exposure.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 9/21 golden cross with bullish OBV and CMF cross-up provide short-term momentum confluence, and extreme fear (31/100) creates contrarian opportunity near support at 13.7033.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary in 10 days combined with VIX crisis (355.36), price below all key EMAs, weak ADX (23.89), stochastic bearish cross, and macro headwinds (flat yield curve, rising dollar, CPI event in 2 days) create compounded execution risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: SMA 9/21 golden cross with bullish OBV and CMF provide short-term momentum, and extreme fear (31/100) creates contrarian setup near support. However, earnings binary in 10 days combined with macro crisis (VIX 355.36, flat yield curve, CPI event in 2 days) creates unacceptable execution risk that negates technical confluence.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 10 days will trigger binary volatility; combined with VIX crisis territory and macro headwinds, downside risk to support is elevated and uncompensated by risk/reward.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk; debate winner (bear) reflects consensus that macro + earnings binary outweigh technical setup
